payload.leagueSummary: NET is a two-man knife fight at the top and then a whole lot of dudes trying to stab each other with a bent wedge. Dan94 and KeithK75 are still separating from the pack with the kind of gross golf that usually turns into net money too, while CRANK keeps proving you can win net when your short game is doing all the heavy lifting and the driver is basically decorative. Behind them, the window is a mixed bag of big misses, save-your-own-ass putting, and a few players who can flash gross scoring for a week before the wheels launch into a bunker.
leagueBullets: Dan94 and KeithK75 are the cleanest golf in the window: both are piling up strong tee-to-green and approach work, which is why they sit near the front in both NET and gross without needing a prayer circle.
CRANK is the weird one: brutal off the tee, fine enough everywhere else, and somehow collecting net wins because the scoring around the green keeps dragging the carcass across the line.
BigTime, DREADFUL, and IUDoc92 are losing strokes in a way that looks expensive fast — too many doubles, too many putts, and not enough birdie pressure to cover the mess.
